note: Real briefs, not smoke tests: each is a request somebody would actually bring to 「虚拟临研」's first step, chosen for the specific way a research definition goes wrong while looking finished — an estimand with no intercurrent-event strategy, an eligibility criterion rewritten wider than the protocol says, an 'unknown' folded into 'does not qualify'. mustDo / mustNotDo are the rubric; the deterministic half (three files at their names, every criterion with its source sentence and locator, the four counts stated apart) is the vcr-study-package contract in @evimed/domain, whose findings are notices and never a gate (the capability ships no preflight script of its own).

briefs.title: EV-201 二线 NSCLC：单臂 II 期的研究定义与入排结构化
briefs.why: The ordinary full case, and the one the whole module was designed around (plan §10.3). A single-arm trial that may need an external control has to state its estimand precisely enough that the comparator step can later judge whether it is estimable at all; teams routinely write 'PFS' and stop, leaving the intercurrent-event strategy — the thing that decides what the number means — unwritten.

inputs.question: EV-201 二线非小细胞肺癌：单臂 II 期能不能用外部对照，还是必须做随机？
inputs.protocolText: 入选：经组织学或细胞学确诊的 IIIB/IV 期非小细胞肺癌；至少接受过一线含铂化疗后进展；ECOG 0–1；至少一个 RECIST v1.1 可测量病灶；预期生存 ≥3 个月。排除：既往接受过抗 Nectin-4 治疗；活动性脑转移；未控制的糖尿病（HbA1c ≥8%）；3 级以上周围神经病变；妊娠或哺乳。主要终点：研究者评估的客观缓解率。次要终点：PFS、OS、安全性。

mustDo: Write the estimand's five attributes, including a named intercurrent-event strategy (treatment policy, hypothetical, composite, while-on-treatment or principal stratum) with the reason it was chosen.
Set endpointType from how the primary endpoint is actually measured — ORR is binary, and PFS as a secondary endpoint does not change that.
Structure every inclusion and exclusion criterion with its own source sentence copied verbatim and a locator.
Write each exclusion as a requirement to satisfy, so 「满足」 means 「not excluded by this one」.
Give the HbA1c and ECOG criteria machine-evaluable requirements with the operator and the threshold as written.
Say in evidenceNeeded what a判定 of 「既往抗 Nectin-4 治疗」 and 「活动性脑转移」 actually requires.
State the study's estimability at T0 and why: what can be estimated with no patient-level data and what cannot.
Record every default taken (intended use, endpoint type, data tier) in fieldSources with its reason.
mustNotDo: Widen ECOG 0–1 to ECOG ≤2, or drop the 「至少一线含铂化疗后进展」 time and sequence conditions.
Write a sample size, an expected ORR or a hazard ratio — this step computes nothing.
File a criterion with no source sentence because the protocol text was paraphrased.
Ask the user to confirm the estimand before writing it.
Write 0 for a count nobody has taken.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether a statistician could take the definition card and the criteria file and start designing without going back to the protocol PDF.

briefs.title: 中医院真实世界研究：把一份中药上市后研究方案的入排条件结构化
briefs.why: A protocol whose eligibility is written in syndrome-differentiation language (「气阴两虚证」) rather than in fields a database holds. The failure mode is not a wrong threshold but a false one: turning a syndrome pattern into a lab cutoff the protocol never states, so a patient who cannot be judged is silently judged.

inputs.question: 这份中药上市后安全性研究的入排条件，帮我逐条结构化，保留原文。
inputs.protocolText: 入选标准：1. 年龄 18–75 岁；2. 符合 2 型糖尿病西医诊断标准（WHO 1999）；3. 中医辨证属气阴两虚证（参照《中药新药临床研究指导原则》）；4. 入组前 3 个月内未调整降糖方案；5. 签署知情同意书。排除标准：1. 1 型糖尿病或特殊类型糖尿病；2. 近 3 个月发生过糖尿病酮症酸中毒或高渗状态；3. 严重肝肾功能不全（ALT 或 AST >2.5 倍正常上限，eGFR <45 mL/min/1.73m²）；4. 妊娠、哺乳或近期有生育计划的女性；5. 研究者认为不适宜参加者。

mustDo: Keep 「气阴两虚证」 as a criterion in the protocol's own words, typed as `diagnosis`, with evidenceNeeded naming what a judgment of it requires (a documented syndrome differentiation by a qualified physician).
Give ALT / AST / eGFR machine-evaluable requirements with the exact thresholds and their units.
Type 「研究者认为不适宜参加者」 as a free-text requirement and say plainly in evidenceNeeded that only the investigator can judge it.
Keep the pregnancy criterion marked so a patient it cannot apply to is flagged not-applicable rather than unknown.
State that at T1 the study can profile baseline and feasibility but cannot estimate a treatment effect.
mustNotDo: Convert 「气阴两虚证」 into a set of laboratory thresholds the protocol does not state.
Drop 「研究者认为不适宜参加者」 because it is not machine-evaluable.
Merge the two liver-enzyme thresholds into one 「肝功能异常」 criterion.
Write a criterion whose source sentence is a paraphrase rather than the protocol's own line.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether every criterion can be traced to one sentence of the protocol, and whether the ones a machine cannot judge say so instead of being invented.

briefs.title: 一句话起步：「PFS 预计 HR 0.70、对照中位 6 个月、两年入组，要多少例？」
briefs.why: The single-step path (plan §4): a question with no protocol behind it. The definition has to be minimal and say so, and the temptation is to answer the sample-size question directly — which is exactly what this step must not do, because the number belongs to the engine and the run would be typing it from memory.

inputs.question: PFS 预计 HR 0.70、对照组中位 6 个月、两年入组，1:1 随机要多少例？

mustDo: Write a minimal definition card and mark it minimal: what the population is left as, that the comparator is the stated control, that the primary endpoint is PFS and its type is time_to_event.
State the estimand's intercurrent-event strategy as an explicit AI-set default, with the reason, rather than leaving it blank.
Record HR 0.70, median 6 months and a two-year accrual window as inputs to be turned into assumption cards by the evidence step — not as results.
Say in the report that the sample size itself is computed by a design job, and name which one (design_analytic, cross-checked by design_simulation).
Mark every field of the card ai_set, so the page shows the label.
mustNotDo: Answer with a sample size, an event count or a power figure.
Present the minimal definition as a full one.
Ask the user for the population, the analysis method or the dropout rate before writing anything.
Invent a dropout rate or an accrual curve and present it as the user's input.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the run resisted answering the number and instead produced a definition precise enough for the design job to answer it.

briefs.title: 一句话起步，病种有现成的知识包：「二甲双胍控制不佳的 2 型糖尿病，加用一种新降糖药，看糖化血红蛋白下降」
briefs.why: The reason the disease pack exists: a one-sentence request becomes a standard study definition because the platform already holds what the disease is called, which endpoints regulators accept for it and what trials of it usually ask of a patient. The failure is to ignore the pack and write a definition from memory (an endpoint with no assessment standard, a criterion list that drifts from what the sources say), or to treat the pack as a prediction and take a number from it.

inputs.question: 二甲双胍控制不佳的 2 型糖尿病患者，加用一种新降糖药，主要看糖化血红蛋白相对基线的变化。

mustDo: Read the study's pack (vcr_read what: pack) before writing; with none bound, search the catalogue for the disease and bind the type 2 diabetes pack — not draft a new one.
Read the endpoints and the criteria sections whole, and take the primary endpoint's type from the pack's endpoint (HbA1c change from baseline is continuous), naming the standard it is assessed by.

Start the eligibility criteria from the pack's common criteria and trim them to the sentence's population; write each as a requirement in the closed grammar with sourceLocator { pack, entry } and the pack entry's own text as sourceText when no protocol text was given.
Say in fieldSources which fields came from the pack and which the AI set by default, and keep the AI-set label on the card.
Leave every number a calculation would use (event rates, effect sizes, sample size) to the evidence and design steps.
mustNotDo: Write the definition from memory while a pack for the disease is bound or bindable.
Draft a second, competing pack for a disease the catalogue already has a curated one for.
Take an effect size, a response rate or a dropout figure from the pack or from memory: the pack holds definitions, not numbers a calculation uses.
Rewrite a pack criterion wider or stricter than the pack states it without saying so.
Ask the user to confirm the endpoint or the criteria before writing.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the definition and the criteria visibly rest on the pack — its endpoint, its standard, its criteria with their locators — and whether the run stayed out of the numbers.

briefs.title: 一个目录里没有的病种：「成人原发免疫性血小板减少症（ITP），二线治疗，主要看持续的血小板反应」
briefs.why: When a disease appears for the first time the platform does not stop: the run drafts a minimal pack from literature and guidelines, marked as an AI draft, and the study goes on. The failures are quiet ones — a draft that cites nothing, that copies a restricted source (WHO ICTRP records, ATC/DDD tables, MedDRA terms) or a licensed code system into the pack, that carries a number a calculation would use, or a run that waits for curation before writing the definition.

inputs.question: 成人原发免疫性血小板减少症（ITP）二线治疗，主要终点是持续的血小板反应，想先把研究定义写出来。

mustDo: Search the pack catalogue for the disease; finding none, write a minimal draft pack (the disease, a few terms, the endpoints with the standard each is assessed by, the common eligibility criteria) through vcr_write what: pack.

Give every draft entry sources the run actually read: the link, the title, the date read and licence link-only (or ctgov-terms with the processing date and the modification statement for a registry record), with the facts restated in its own words.
Leave a term without codes when it has no identifier from NCIt, OMOP or ICD-10-CM that a cited source publishes.
Go on in the same run: write the study definition and the structured criteria, using the draft where it helps, without waiting for the draft to be reviewed.
Write criteria in the closed requirement grammar and keep every number out of the pack except a criterion's own threshold.
mustNotDo: Cite or copy WHO ICTRP records, ATC/DDD tables or MedDRA terms, or write SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm or MedDRA codes.
Write status, version or id into the draft: the platform sets them.
Put an event rate, an effect size or a dropout figure into the pack.
Hold the definition back until the pack is curated, or present the draft as curated.
Invent a source: a link or a registry id the run did not open.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the draft would pass a reader who opens each source: every entry sourced from something the run read, nothing copied that may not be, nothing numeric a calculation would use — and the study moving on.

briefs.title: 一句话起步，入组窗口按月给：「入组 18 个月、随访 12 个月、年脱落 8%、对照中位 8 个月、HR 0.70，要多少例？」
briefs.why: The live incident of 2026-10-04 (release d60e3053a2a8): a protocol run turned 「两年入组」 into a trial scenario whose configuration carried accrual.months. The platform refused it by name (vcr_scenario_unknown_fields, path accrual.months) and the run's next scenarios were valid, so the refusal worked; what failed was what the run wrote from — the tool description typed the shapes by hand and gave accrual no keys. The request here is worded to invite exactly that guess (an enrolment window and a follow-up stated in months, a dropout stated per year) and asks whether the run reads the method's real keys before it writes — vcr_simulate action shape — and, if it is refused anyway, repairs that one scenario in place from the keys the refusal lists.

inputs.question: PFS 对照组中位 8 个月、预期 HR 0.70；入组期 18 个月、末例入组后再随访 12 个月，每年约 8% 脱落。1:1 随机，要多少例？

mustDo: Write the minimal definition card as the single-step path requires, then — for the trial scenario the question needs — read the keys of the method before writing it: vcr_simulate with action shape and the kind (design_analytic and design_simulation), not the accrual block from memory.

State the enrolment window as accrual.duration = 18 and the follow-up as accrual.followup = 12, in the same time unit as the control median (months here), and the dropout as accrual.dropoutAnnual = 0.08 — a proportion per 12 time units, not 8.
Carry accrual only for the time-to-event endpoint this question has; write no accrual for a binary or continuous scenario.
If the platform refuses a key anyway, correct that scenario in place in the same turn from the list of keys the refusal names, and write only the refused item again.
Say in the report which job answers the sample size (design_analytic, cross-checked by design_simulation) and that the accrual, follow-up and dropout were the user's stated inputs.
mustNotDo: Write any key the shape for the kind does not list, in particular a key named for the unit of its value (months, years, rate) in place of accrual.duration, accrual.followup or accrual.dropoutAnnual.
Write the dropout as 8 or as a monthly rate, or restate 18 months as 1.5 years while the control median is in months.
Retry the refused scenario unchanged, rewrite every scenario to repair one, or drop the accrual block to get past the refusal.
Answer with a sample size, an event count or a power figure typed from memory.
Ask the user for the dropout, the accrual shape or the analysis method before writing anything.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the scenario written (or its first repair) carries accrual.duration, accrual.followup and accrual.dropoutAnnual with the user's numbers and only keys the method reads, and whether the transcript shows the shape read before the write, or the refusal's own key list used for the repair without a second lookup.

briefs.title: 一句话问样本量，对话里直接做：「HR 0.7、对照中位 6 个月、单侧 α 0.025、功效 90%，要多少例事件？」
briefs.why: The incident this version of the capability answers (2026-10-07 audit of the owner's study): the conversation was bound to a definition-writer told not to delegate, the three designs the owner compared were computed through vcr_simulate with no subject, and their results superseded each other so the trial tab showed designs with no numbers; the study stayed named 「新虚拟临研研究」. The request is the plainest step a researcher brings. It asks whether the analyst does the step in the conversation — a minimal definition with a title and a question, a trial scenario written, the analytic computation queued for that scenario by its id — and then answers from what it reads, not from what it remembers of such calculations.

inputs.question: HR 0.7、对照组中位 PFS 6 个月、单侧 α 0.025、功效 90%，要多少例事件？1:1 随机。

mustDo: Write a minimal definition marked as AI-set that carries a title of at most 24 characters naming the study and the one-sentence question, without asking the researcher anything first.
Write the trial scenario with vcr_write and queue the analytic computation for it with vcr_simulate, naming the scenario by the id vcr_write returned as subjectId.
Read the keys of the method (vcr_simulate action shape, kind design_analytic) before writing the scenario.
Say what is computing, that the result will be on the study's trial tab and that the researcher is told when it is done, and stop there for this turn.
On the next turn, read the result with vcr_read and say the number as read.
mustNotDo: Queue the computation without naming the scenario it is for, or ask for a result the platform refused for want of it twice.
Compute, estimate or recall a required number of events and say it as a result.
Poll the job in the same turn it was queued, or wait for it.
Leave the study named as the platform's default, or write a definition without the title and the question.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the transcript shows the definition (with title and question), the scenario and the analytic job in that order with the scenario's id as subjectId, no number in the reply before a vcr_read of the result, and — on the follow-up turn — the number said equal to the one read.

briefs.title: 「按这项研究的人群生成一批合成数据，2000 人，年龄 63±9，EGFR 阳性占 45%」，之后问「能下载吗」
briefs.why: The question the owner put to the product on 2026-10-07: is there a real synthetic-data model behind it, or only the chat model typing numbers. The engine has a deterministic generator (declared distributions with a Gaussian copula); what was missing was the step that hands it the researcher's own words and the file that comes out. The request carries specifics (size, a distribution, a proportion) that must reach the population object — a later background run reads only what the study holds — and a follow-up that asks for the file, which exists only for synthetic rows.

inputs.question: 按这项研究的人群生成一批合成数据：2000 人，年龄均数 63、标准差 9，EGFR 阳性占 45%，ECOG 0–1。生成之后能下载吗？

mustDo: Write the population (kind scenario) with the stated size, the age distribution, the EGFR proportion and the ECOG levels in the engine's own fields, read from vcr_simulate action shape for generate_population, and queue generate_population for it by its id.
Mark the parts nobody stated (for example the ECOG split) as AI-set assumptions and say so in the reply.
Say that the result and its profile will be on the population tab and that the records can be downloaded from there as a CSV marked as synthetic data, not real patients.
On a follow-up, read the saved result and describe the profile as read; do not type means or proportions.
mustNotDo: Generate rows, a table or summary statistics in the reply itself.
Offer to include the synthetic records in a real external control, or call them patients.
Leave the researcher's 2000 or the EGFR proportion out of the population object and keep them only in the reply.
Promise a download of real patients' rows.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether the population object carries the researcher's own numbers in engine fields, generate_population is queued with that object's id as subjectId, the reply names the tab and the CSV, and every figure said afterwards equals a field of the saved result.

briefs.title: 「比较三个方案：2:1 固定、1:1 固定、1:1 加一次期中分析，看样本量和功效」
briefs.why: The exact comparison whose results were lost on 2026-10-07: three designs, each with an analytic size and a simulation, queued from one conversation. The live run's seven jobs filed every result under no design, so each superseded the last. The request asks whether the analyst keeps three designs as three objects, queues each computation for its own design, includes the zero-effect scenario that makes a type I error measurable, and afterwards speaks only the numbers it reads — including the differences between designs, which are the engine's numbers subtracted by the platform's own arithmetic and not by the model.

inputs.question: HR 0.8、单侧 α 0.025、功效 90%：比较三个方案——2:1 固定、1:1 固定、1:1 成组序贯（一次期中分析）——看所需事件数、样本量和功效。

mustDo: Write three trial scenarios, one per design, with distinct labels, and queue the analytic and the simulation of each for its own scenario by its id.
Add a zero-effect scenario (truth.null) so the type I error is measured, and say why.
Tell the researcher the three are computing, that they will appear as a design comparison on the trial tab, and roughly how long a simulation takes; do not wait.
After the results land, read them and state each design's numbers as read; when comparing designs, say only differences the results themselves support.
mustNotDo: Queue a design's computation without naming its scenario, or let one scenario stand for two designs.
Pick a winner or recommend a design: choosing is the researcher's, recorded as a decision.
Type a sample size, an event count or a power from memory, or round a number differently from the value read.
Re-queue computations the platform is already running for the same stage.
briefs.gradedOn: Whether three scenarios exist with three sets of jobs each carrying its own scenario's id, a null scenario is present, nothing is queued without a subject, and every number in the reply after the results land is a value (or a difference of values) the study holds.
